name: Hasuksaeng-i Jeonbu Minyeoimnidaman?
source:
[Five Hearts Under One Roof] is a fully immersive interactive video game that simulates a love story with five unique heroines. As the player, you take on the role of Yuman, who has always been home alone. Now, you’ll be running a lively, love-filled boarding house with five fascinating heroines.

Who will be by your side in the end?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021100/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《阿西, 美女室友竟然...？》是一款沉浸式互動影像遊戲，模擬了與五位性格各異的女主角之間的愛情故事。你將扮演一直獨居的吳宥萬。現在，你要經營一間生氣勃勃、充滿愛意的寄宿公寓，與五位迷人的女主角同住一個屋簷下。

最後，誰會陪在你身邊？

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021100/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof/]Steam[/url]］
